cohort: 354,287 women from communities in Argentina, Democratic Republic of Congo, Guatemala, India, Kenya, Pakistan, and Zambia
finding: In low- and middle-income countries, the rate of operative vaginal deliveries decreased, while the cesarean delivery rate increased over a 7-year period.
mod_finding: This study observed a decreasing trend in operative vaginal deliveries and an increasing trend in cesarean deliveries in low- and middle-income countries.
country: Multiple (Argentina, Democratic Republic of Congo, Guatemala, India, Kenya, Pakistan, and Zambia)
